name: Open World
author: htubdawg
description: Free roam in a 32 km (20 mile) square of country generated from a fixed seed the way real country comes about: rivers and lakes, a market town, villages and farms where people would settle, a road network grown in order of importance, houses and high-street shops along the streets, glass towers in the town centre, a retail park and filling stations, village churches, sidewalks, parks with ponds, trails round the lakes, a race circuit with pits and grandstands, a gravel rally stage through the upland forest, a hill climb up a mountain valley to a col, farm tracks and footpaths that mostly run on to another road, road signs (a name sign at the way into every town and village, fingerposts where main roads meet and at country junctions, brown signs to the courses), farms, woods of the Forest's pines, grass and fields. Built in the Tokyo scene; the weather is drawn each race. A floating origin keeps the physics precise anywhere. Works in Multiplayer rooms with the Multiplayer mod as it is.
